name: io.github.nedzof/nektar
title: nektar — Verifiable Agent Memory & Knowledge Market
description: Verifiable, encrypted AI agent memory anchored on BSV with checkable answer receipts and policy-controlled knowledge trading. Zero-config testnet boot with a seeded welcome shard.

environmentVariables.name: NEKTAR_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: BSV network: testnet (default zero-config), regtest, or main

environmentVariables.name: NEKTAR_TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Exposed tool surface: agent (10 curated tools, default) or operator (full admin/ZK surface)

environmentVariables.name: NEKTAR_KEY_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional on testnet (keys stay mode-0600); required on mainnet to encrypt keys at rest

environmentVariables.name: NEKTAR_AUTOMATION
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable the policy-gated knowledge marketplace (want/sell/deals)
